verdict.rationale: Drata's developer portal says it can 'automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions' while monitoring controls, evidence, and personnel, which matches the story's event-driven rules. That support rests on a single one-line marketing claim with no detail on how rules are built or what they can do. Custom monitoring tests and API CRUD endpoints are adjacent building blocks, not trigger/action rules, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of the rule definition model, a list of supported trigger events and actions, examples or a UI/API for configuring workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
